title: form of a subsystem manifest, P/02.1
description: the root is a mapping with a closed set of sections

id.description: `numeric` or a non-secret field of type string (N1.4)

state.description: unit state — name → schema of the row `<sub>/state/<name>/<unit>` (ADR-0091 item 3); `cursor` — the cursor of the unit

writes_via.description: the rows are written only by the named subsystems with a ticket; a session, the emergency login and other tickets — 403 writes via; a write by the right of consequences is outside the word (P/06.1 N1.1a, ADR-0119 addendum (10), (11))

by.x-default-text: all fields of the row except these

kinds.description: event kind → `{severity}`; the label of the kind is `display.kinds` (ADR-0115 addendum (3) item 6, addendum (4) item 2)

sub.description: subsystem name by the `name` grammar; existence is not a check of the loader

snapshot.description: list of fields without `*_secret`, blob and `server` and the states `state.<name>`; `[]` — none
snapshot.x-default-text: all fields except these, and all states except `cursor`

exec.description: the program of the subsystem's worker — the service unit of the cluster worker and of the worker on the domain runs it through the runner (`w2c-run.sh worker`, `domainworker`; P/02.4 N1.1, N1.12), the slot is the last argument for the cluster (ADR-0091 addendum (4), (5))

writes.description: own tables, not `unit.rows`; a table with a declared `*_secret` field — refusal: its rows are written only by the worker, the console has no write to them, and the console ring does not see them: a change of the ring would leave them under the old key (P/06.2 N3 «reseal at start»); the list form declares no fields, its secrets are resealed by the worker itself (P/03.4 N1.6 `list_secret`)

requests.description: other subsystems (the own one — refusal; whether it accepts — catalogue, N3)

deletes.description: families of the units of this manifest — only `unit.rows` (ADR-0067 addendum 2026-10-17)
deletes.x-default-text: the worker does not delete unit rows

creates.description: unit rows of another subsystem that the worker of this one creates and renews (ADR-0091 item 1); the addressee, its `unit.rows` and the `key` fields — a catalogue check (N3)
creates.x-default-text: the worker creates no foreign rows

sub.description: the addressee subsystem; the own one — refusal

key.description: substitutions `{field}` of the addressee joined by `-`, without `:int` (P/03.6 N1.6 `key`)

uses.description: shares of other subsystems `<subsystem>.<share>` (their `shares`; catalogue, N3) — the group of the share in the service unit of the worker

stop_timeout.description: stop seconds of the worker's service unit — `TimeoutStopSec` (macOS — `ExitTimeOut`); the upper bound 50 is one rule for all workers (ADR-0091 addendum (2) item 1, addendum (3) item 4)

name_env.x-default-text: the name is not taken from the environment

strings.description: names of heartbeat fields, not from `platform_strings` of P/03.4 N1.1

door.description: heartbeat fields that the door `GET /<sub>/heartbeats` returns (P/06.7 N1.6 pulse): fields of the subsystem, not of the heartbeat family of P/03.4 N1.1 and not secret; no key — no door

stale_after.description: the stale threshold of the subsystem's heartbeats at the agent, s (P/09.1 N1.2 stale): not less than three heartbeat periods HEARTBEAT_EVERY 10 s (P/03.4 N1.1); no key — LOST_AFTER 45 s

shares.description: shared parts of the subsystem for workers of other subsystems (ADR-0091 item 5): name → kind

part.description: a part from `parts` of this subsystem — the producer of the share: the directory and the socket belong to the user and group of the part (ADR-0091 addendum (2) item 4)

parts.description: parts of the subsystem with their own service and user (ADR-0091 item 5): name → service

exec.description: command of the part's service — the same grammar as `worker.exec` (ADR-0091 addendum (5) item 2)

stop_timeout.description: stop seconds of the part's service unit — `TimeoutStopSec` (macOS — `ExitTimeOut`; ADR-0091 addendum (2) item 1, addendum (3) item 4)

routes.description: routes of the process door — the first segment of the request path, byte for byte (the door token contract; the Architect's decision of 2026-10-20); an element is a name (admission `token`: a door token) or `{name, role?, domain?, rank?}` (admission by a role certificate, class `mixed` of the role certificate contract, and/or by a domain token; ADR-0091 addendum (7), (8), (14))

then.description: a route with admission `token` — by the `name` grammar (without «/»)

role.description: roles whose presented certificate admits to the route

domain.description: kinds of domain tokens that admit to the route (P/03.4 N1.7 door_admission domain); each kind is declared in domain.tokens of a subsystem of the catalogue, otherwise `refused:catalogue` (N3; ADR-0091 addendum (14) item 1)

rank.description: route rank: the token of the door `/where` carries the route only if the person's rank on the unit is not lower (P/06.5 N3); no key — `view`; only for a route with admission `token` — without `role` and `domain` (ADR-0115 addendum (19) item 1)

then.description: the first kind: the first segments of the path

shell.description: `true` — the console serves the shell `<sub>.shell.html` of this subsystem, a mounted one (P/06.5 N1.1 `mounted`); no file next to the manifest — `manifest put` refusal (P/02.3 N4)

files.description: static files of the subsystem: paths relative to the directory of the manifest file, console address `/<sub>/<path>` (P/06.5 N2 «Статические файлы»); a file not read — `manifest put` refusal (P/02.3 N4)

items.description: segments separated by `/`, each starts with a letter, a digit or `_` (hence no `..`, no absolute path and no empty segment); the extension is from a closed list, without `html`; not under `api/` — that is the route space of the mounted subsystem (ADR-0094 addendum (4) item 2, addendum (8) item 2)

book.description: `{}` — a portable book: written by the worker of the subsystem on the domain (P/03.7 N1.6); `{show}` — the same book with showing; `{from, key, pick, to, show?, stale?}` — a book assembled from the rows of members

from.description: `<sub>/<row>` — a single row, or `<sub>/<row>/` — a family of rows under slots; `<sub>` is the own subsystem

key.description: name of a non-secret input field by the `name` grammar: the value is a non-empty string, the key of the book (review of stage A 8–10, № 42; the Architect's decision of 2026-10-20)

to.description: name of a non-secret input field by the `name` grammar, not `key`: a member or a list of members — the recipients of the element; "*" — a book for all (P/08.5 N1.3 to_all) (review of stage A 8–10, № 42; the Architect's decision of 2026-10-20)

stale.description: book to: "*": the head carries the servers whose worker of this subsystem is silent (P/08.5 N1.3 head; ADR-0113 addendum (31)–(33))

boundTo.description: a field name or a list of field names of this row, not secrets

login.description: a row field that is neither url nor secret

fields.description: field name → label; a table field — `<t>.<field>` (ADR-0115 addendum (3) item 3)

field_help.description: field name → hint; a table field — `<t>.<field>`

options.description: field → `{value: caption}`; a table field — `<t>.<field>` (ADR-0115 addendum (4) item 1)

keys.description: id of a domain key family → label

folders.description: `true` — the page tree is built by the folders of the cluster, and the units of `unit.rows` can be their members (P/06.8 N1.1; P/06.5 N1.2 `tree`)

field.description: a field or a platform name

tables.description: table name → label of the kind (`name_key` psim): a string or `{key, text}`, translations — `display.langs`; the name is a table of `tables` (ADR-0115 addendum (11))

view_pulse.description: heartbeat fields; `stale` is a platform word in `pulse.<sub>` of the view (P/08.1 N1.4)

kept_read.description: domain.kept rows that the domain console door reads: exact names, not families

shared.description: an element is a name of a unit field (not a secret; it inherits or is `display.tree.group_by`) or a document `{name, type: json, schema}`: name is not a name of a unit field, the value of the document is checked by schema

propertyNames.description: token kind; the kind is unique in the catalogue (N3, `refused:catalogue`)

member_field.description: the fixed field of the unit that carries the name of the member

execLine.description: command line without a shell: words separated by one space U+0020, no empty words; the first word is an absolute path; in words — printable ASCII without " ' \ % $ ` ; | & < > * ? ( ) { } [ ] ~ # !; argv is the split by space (ADR-0091 addendum (5) item 2)

fieldEnum.description: values of the field type; only for string and bool

items.description: with `/`; without a literal `*`, a leading `!` and `delete:`

grantName.description: without a literal `*`, a leading `!` and `delete:`

jsonSchemaLite.description: JSON Schema 2020-12; the keywords are the list `names.key` of this definition (anything else is value), depth ≤ 32 (review of stage A 6–7, № 11)

label.description: a string or `{key, text}`: the translation key by `display.langs` and the text if there is no translation (ADR-0115 addendum (2) item 3)

langs.description: language → `{key: text}`; the generator puts translations here; a key absent in the language — the `text` of the label applies (ADR-0115 addendum (2) item 3)

where.description: the keys are fields; with `count` — table fields

mustMatch.description: `{<target field>: <field of this row>}`; the keys are not checked

passCall.description: a callback door from the closed list of P/06.3 N1.9: `<s>/<name>` — unit rows, a table, `policy`, `next_id` or a door route of subsystem `<s>`; the prefix `GET ` — read only; `console/batch`, `changes`, `folders`; `<s>/operations`; `<s>/requests`; `marks`; `GET <s>/where`; `GET <s>/heartbeats`; the door `door.pass` of the first kind; `servers/labels`; `GET manifest|servers|events|session|schema`; `GET manifest/<s>/source` (ADR-0116 addendum (6)); domain doors: `GET domain/users|groups|roles|grants`, `domain/batch`, `domain/verify` (ADR-0119), `domain/shared`, `GET domain/shared/<s>`, `GET domain/topology`; the book door: `GET domain/<s>/books/<book>`; a book section for all: `GET domain/<s>/books/<book>/*`; a kept row: `GET domain/<s>/kept/<name>`

passRoute.description: route path: segments by the `name` grammar separated by `/`; matches the start of the path by whole segments

passTicket.description: the second kind: a ticket per request instead of a person's credential (P/06.5 N1.8, the gate-and-pass contract)

routes.description: passed routes; the first segment — as in the first kind

calls.description: console doors that the worker calls back with a ticket

stream.description: routes passed as a stream; each lies under a route of `routes`

wait.description: wait limit of the route, seconds; the key lies under a route of `routes`, the longest one wins; the ceiling is `PASS_WAIT_MAX`
wait.x-default-text: `PASS_WAIT`; for a stream — until the end of the request

refusals.description: the form of console refusals on these routes; no key — ConsoleRefusal

codes.description: console status → `code`; the key in quotes; a status not in the map — ConsoleRefusal

operations.description: group operations of the subsystem (P/06.9 N1.1): the step call route, own limits, a service table

step.description: the step call route; does not lie under `routes`: unavailable to the browser

limits.description: own limits, not above the ceilings of P/06.9 N1.6

parallel.description: operations conducted at the same time

service.description: the operations table is a service table: doors only with a ticket, a person sees their own operation (P/06.9 N2)

unit_mb.x-default-text: the memory budget is not checked (P/03.4 N1.2 `memory`)

base_mb.description: the memory budget is the one formula of P/03.4 N1.2 `memory`, the check is P/03.4 N3 «start() — the budget step»

wanted.description: table: a row with the name of the place — the place needs a holder (P/04 N3 «shortage()»)

cut_at.description: only for a url field: for a field of another type — `refused:relations` (the type is a property of the target `group_by.field`, as for `unit.id`)

home.description: a field or the word `near` (then `near` is required)

exclusive.description: exclusive place: the holder of a binding place (by `strict`) accepts only units bound to it and takes no other places (P/04 N1.3, P/03.2 N3; ADR-0091 addendum (9) item 6, addendum (10) items 1–2)

state.description: name of a `unit.state`: the field is its (ADR-0091 item 3)
state.x-default-text: the field is of the unit rows

field.description: a field of the unit row or, with `state`, a field of that state

delete_after.description: seconds from retirement to physical deletion of the row (ADR-0091 item 1)

ends.description: unit term: the field ≠ `never` and not later than the controller's clock — retire and delete (ADR-0091 item 2)

field.description: a field of type int or float — Unix seconds

delete_after.description: only with a named id (`numeric` — a refusal); `fixed` fields and `about` by any field are allowed since ADR-0091 item 1: for a table with `fixed` fields the controller physically deletes only the rows with `made`, the manual ones it takes off without deleting (P/04 Н1.3)

refTarget.description: `<subsystem>/<family>`, both parts are names by N1.2; the loader does not look for the target

key.description: rid template with at least one `{…}` (N1.4): without a substitution all requests would get one id

outcome.description: the meaning is P/06.4 N1.5 (`mark`), chapter 3.6 (the append of `fetched`), ADR-0054 addendum 2026-10-17; `fetched` requires `requests.key` (N1.4)

elsewhere.description: actions are the values of the body field `action` (the mark contract, «Request» `action`); the loader does not check them against `requests.schema` — the check is the manifest author's: the checklist and `check_spec` for the manifests of the course (the Architect's decision, review of stage B 6–7, № 17)

requests.description: actions are the values of the body field `action` (the mark contract, «Request» `action`); the loader does not check them against `requests.schema` — the check is the manifest author's: the checklist and `check_spec` for the manifests of the course (the Architect's decision, review of stage B 6–7, № 17)

action.description: object key: the action of a request to a unit (the gate-and-pass contract, names)

at.description: a path inside the field value: keys separated by dots, [] — each element (the gate-and-pass contract, names)

kinds.description: target kind → subsystem, folder or server

quiet.description: keys of an object without a target (the gate-and-pass contract, names)

rowsName.description: a name by N1.2, not from the list of forbidden table names and not `cluster`, `worker`, `ts`

schemes.description: scheme name → `{host?, fragment?, none?}`; the meaning is the address contract «Schemes» (URLC-HOST-01)
schemes.x-owner: the address contract url-credentials «Schemes»; P/06.2 N1.1

host.description: `authority` — the host is the authority component; `path` — the host is the first path segment, the authority component is the hub (`mirror://<hub>/<host>/…`)

fragment.description: `none`: `#` is an ordinary character, not the start of a fragment (P/06.2 N1.1a A2)

none.description: values of the authority component that mean «no host» (`mirror://local/…` — the own copy); the path is required only with `host: path` — the address contract «Schemes»

items.description: an element of exactly one kind: `{param, login?}`, `{regex, in?, schemes?, decoded?}` or `{nested}`

readers.description: exact row name or prefix with `/` → roles

field.description: a path in the heartbeat; the first segment is not a heartbeat key of the platform (P/03.4 N1.1)

subName.description: not one of the 36 reserved words and does not start with `free-` (the submitter's rid `<subsystem>.<key>` would otherwise start with `free-`, which the rid grammar forbids; ADR-0091 addendum (24) item 5); the name is the first segment of all keys of the subsystem `<name>/…` and of its place on the domain

key.description: a non-secret string field or a template `{field}` / `{field:int}` (N1.4)

fields.description: a field by the table «Field»; the fields `held_by`, `garbled`, `by`, `at`, `made_at`, `revision`, `index` are forbidden

service.description: service table of the worker: only with a ticket (P/06.1 N1.6 `service`)

writes_via.description: the rows are written only by the named subsystems with a ticket; a session, the emergency login and other tickets — 403 writes via; a write by the right of consequences is outside the word (P/06.1 N1.1a, ADR-0119 addendum (10), (11))

delete_after.description: row term in seconds; the console reaper removes the row (P/06.4 N3 `tables`)

allOf.description: service already admits only a ticket of its own subsystem (P/06.1 N1.6)

hidden.description: the field is not shown by the form; the door writes and returns the value like the others (ADR-0115 item 2.2)

items.description: for `type: list`: `ref` of each element is a form hint, the list of values is taken by reading the family; the platform does not judge the value by it (ADR-0115 addendum (2) item 5, addendum (3) item 5)

ref_label.description: name of a field of the target row of `ref` or `items.ref` — the label of the value in the form; the loader does not look for the target field (ADR-0115 addendum (5) item 2, addendum (6) item 2)

tableName.description: a name by N1.2, not from the list of forbidden table names

tables.description: a named mapping (name → table) or a list of names

keep.description: the token lies sealed on the worker's medium (P/03.7 N1.5 keep; ADR-0110 addendum (9))

grant.description: roles of the workers to which the kind is issued

sub.description: subsystem of the assignment records (P/08.6 N1.1)

caller.description: the field of the record where the applicant member must stand

sub.description: subsystem of the unit; none — the own one (the own one requires `domain.ref`)

doc.description: subsystem of the shared document (P/08.9 N1.2: `shared.<doc>`)

items.description: name of the array in the document

placement.description: the subsystem whose assignment records name the home of the target

default.description: one value of the field type: for float an integer is admissible, list — a list of strings, json — any JSON value (a mapping for string — refusal); null — no default; from `enum`, if there is one

inherit.description: like `default`; the last link of the inheritance chain; only for a unit field

merge.description: reduction of the inheritance chain; only with `inherit`; `union` — only for `type: list`

unique.description: `canonical` — comparison by the canonical form of the URL (P/06.1 N1.3), only for url; not for list

hidden.description: the field is not shown by the form; the door writes and returns the value like the others (ADR-0115 item 2.2)

items.description: for `type: list`: `ref` of each element is a form hint, the list of values is taken by reading the family; the platform does not judge the value by it (ADR-0115 addendum (2) item 5, addendum (3) item 5)

ref_label.description: name of a field of the target row of `ref` or `items.ref` — the label of the value in the form; the loader does not look for the target field (ADR-0115 addendum (5) item 2, addendum (6) item 2)

propertyNames.description: not from `platform_fields` of P/06.1 N1.2; without a dot: the name `<t>.<field>` in `display` is a table field (ADR-0115 addendum (4) item 1)
